entities.name: Muqaddimah (Ibn Khaldun)
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Written in 1377 by the North African polymath Ibn Khaldun, the Muqaddimah ("Introduction") is widely considered the foundational work of sociology, historiography, and economic theory. It introduces the concept of 'asabiyyah (group solidarity) as the driving force of civilizational rise and decline, analyzes economic cycles, and criticizes uncritical historical methods — centuries before Enlightenment thinkers addressed the same questions.
